resources.string: Relay is an independent, third-party wrapper application. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Meta Platforms, Inc. or Instagram.

Relay collects zero personal data, credentials, or analytics. There are no Relay servers, accounts, trackers, or third-party SDKs. You sign in directly on instagram.com inside the app, and all authentication data (cookies, cache, and local storage) is handled locally on your device by standard Android WebKit storage, exchanged only with Instagram’s servers. Your Instagram username may be remembered on your device so the Profile tab can open your profile; it never leaves your device and is erased by Clear Data & Logout. Instagram’s own Privacy Policy and Terms apply to everything you do on Instagram.

Relay is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose, availability, or uninterrupted operation. To the maximum extent permitted by law, the developer(s) of Relay shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages, including loss of data, loss of account access, or account restrictions, arising from your use of, or inability to use, the app. You are solely responsible for complying with Instagram’s Terms of Use. Relay may stop working at any time if Instagram changes its website.
